displayName: User Account Control Type Of Admin Approval Mode
description: User Account Control: Configure type of Admin Approval Mode. This policy setting controls whether Administrator protection is applied to admin approval mode elevations. If you change this policy setting, you must restart your computer. This policy is only supported on Windows Desktop, not Server. The options are: • Admin Approval Mode is running in legacy mode (default). • Admin Approval Mode is running with Administrator protection.

options.displayName: Admin Approval Mode with Administrator protection
options.description: Admin Approval Mode with Administrator protection
